verdict.rationale: A runtime probe confirms three.js is published on npm as `three` (v0.186.0, about 12.2M weekly downloads, MIT license verified), and notes that coding agents drive it directly through npm as an imported library. A community report adds that it works with TypeScript, a sign it slots into standard toolchains. Missing for 10: no evidence of tree-shaking or ES-module side-effect-free packaging, no documented bundler integration (the docs push import maps instead), and some @types/three signature mismatches were reported.
